record.name: Zoho CRM
record.one_liner: Zoho CRM provides REST APIs, GraphQL, SDKs, and developer tools for building integrations, custom functions, widgets, and agentic workflows.

access.notes: Developers can sign up for a free trial or use the fully featured free Developer Edition directly.

api_surface.notes: Zoho CRM offers REST APIs, GraphQL APIs, bulk and notification APIs, and SDKs.
